'''Carlo Violani''' (born 1946), is an Italian zoologist at the [[University of Pavia]] department of animal biology.<ref name="Jobling">[https://www.hbw.com/dictionary/key-to-scientific-names-in-ornithology?name=Violania name: Violania] Jobling, J. A. (2018). ''Key to Scientific Names in Ornithology''. In: del Hoyo, J., Elliott, A., Sargatal, J., Christie, D.A. & de Juana, E. (eds.) (2018). ''Handbook of the Birds of the World Alive''. Lynx Edicions, Barcelona.</ref> A genus was named for the author, ''Violania'',<ref name="Jobling" /> for a taxonomic treatment of the contentious genus ''[[Platycercus]]'' (rosellas),<ref name="Shipham2015">{{cite journal |last1=Shipham |first1=Ashlee |last2=Schmidt |first2=Daniel J. |last3=Joseph |first3=Leo |last4=Hughes |first4=Jane M. |title=Phylogenetic analysis of the Australian rosella parrots (''Platycercus'') reveals discordance among molecules and plumage |journal=Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution |date=October 2015 |volume=91 |pages=150–159 |doi=10.1016/j.ympev.2015.05.012 |pmid=26021439 |bibcode=2015MolPE..91..150S |issn=1055-7903}}</ref> recognised as a subgenus ''[[Platycercus (Violania)|''Platycercus'' (''Violania'')]]'' Wells & Wellington, 1992 by later authorities.<ref name="AFD">{{cite web |title=Subspecies ''Platycercus'' (''Violania'') Wells & Wellington, 1992 |url=https://biodiversity.org.au/afd/taxa/Platycercus_%28Violania%29 |website=[[Australian Faunal Directory]] |publisher=Department of the Environment and Energy |accessdate=23 October 2018}}</ref>
